# TextField

## Purpose

A single-line form field: a visible label above a text, email or password input.

## When to use

- Any short single-value input in a form, such as an email or a password.

## When NOT to use

- For multi-line text, selects, checkboxes or radio buttons: no component exists for them yet.
- For the button that sends the form: use [Button](../Button/Button.md) with `type="submit"`.
- For a search box or an inline filter: it needs different semantics.

## Props

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | — | Yes | Visible label shown above the field. Never replace it with a placeholder. |
| `name` | `string` | — | Yes | Field name sent with the form; also builds the input `id` (`field-<name>`). |
| `type` | `"text" \| "email" \| "password"` | `"text"` | No | Kind of value; picks the mobile keyboard and native validation. |
| `autocomplete` | `"email" \| "username" \| "current-password" \| "new-password"` | none | No | Autofill hint (WCAG 1.3.5). |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | No | Sets the native `required` attribute. |

## Variants

None. One look for every type.

## Tokens used

`color.surface-card`, `color.border-field`, `color.text-strong`, `border.field`, `radius.field`, `space.8`, `space.16`, `text.body-sm`, `text.data-value`, `text.lead`. The global focus ring (`color.focus-ring`) applies.

## Accessibility

- A real `<label for>` tied to the input; the label is always visible.
- The field border is `color.border-field` (5.10:1 on white, above the 3:1 UI minimum); text is `color.text-strong` (16.62:1).
- The global focus ring is kept; the component never removes the outline.
- The height is 48px, above the 24px target-size minimum.
- The input font size is 16px or more at every width, so iOS does not zoom in on focus.

## Examples

```astro
<TextField label="Correo electrónico" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" required />
<TextField label="Contraseña" name="password" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" required />
```

## Do / Don't

- Do give every field a `label`. Don't use a placeholder instead.
- Do set `autocomplete` on account fields. Don't leave it off for email and password.
- Do use the matching `type`. Don't use `type="text"` for an email or password.
- Don't override colours or borders from the page; add a token instead.

content.text:
The login page is at `/login` and works on mobile and tablet. I checked screenshots at 375px and 820px: no horizontal overflow, and the card is full width on mobile and centered at up to 420px on tablet. `npx astro check` shows 0 errors, 0 warnings and 0 hints. `npm run docs:check` and `npm run ds:validate` pass. The contrast audit shows no failures at 375, 768, 834, 1024 and 1440px. I did not compare against Figma.

**Page**
- It uses the hero gradient with the Batatabit logo, which links home.
- A white card holds the heading "Ingresa a tu cuenta." (the page's single `h1`), the "Correo electrónico" and "Contraseña" fields, the "¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?" link and the "Ingresar" button.
- All text sits on the white card, because the gradient is reserved for the hero lead.

**Design-system changes**
- **`TextField`:** a new component with its guide and an entry in `docs/components.md`. It has a visible label, `required`, and `autocomplete` hints for email and current password.
- **Tokens:** I added `color.border-field` (5.10:1 on white), `border.field` and `radius.field`, then regenerated `tokens.css`.
- **`Button`:** it now takes `type="submit"`. It still defaults to `type="button"`, so existing uses are unchanged. I updated its guide too.
- **`BaseLayout`:** it now takes an optional `title`, so the tab reads "Ingresar | Batatabit" instead of the home title.

**Not wired up yet**
- The form has `method="post"` but no action, and nothing handles it. Submitting will fail on this static site until you add a backend or an action URL. I avoided `GET` because it would put the password in the URL.
- The "¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?" link points to `#` because there is no recovery page yet.
